Overview

Palembang is a city in South Sumatra with a population of 1,708,000. South Sumatra’s capital and one of Indonesia’s oldest cities, known for its Ampera Bridge and pempek cuisine. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
